wondering-eye.hint.target: The eye follows this token as it moves. Stored by token and by actor, so it survives the token being replaced.
wondering-eye.hint.pupilSrc: Leave blank for the built-in glowing slit pupil.
wondering-eye.hint.glow: Blend the pupil additively. Looks best over dark artwork.
wondering-eye.hint.socket: Where the eye sits, as a fraction of this object's size measured from its centre. Use Pick on canvas.
wondering-eye.hint.travel: How far the pupil moves from the socket, as a fraction of size. Different X and Y give an almond-shaped eye.
wondering-eye.hint.pupilScale: Pupil diameter as a fraction of this object's width.
wondering-eye.hint.gazeAmount: 0 keeps the pupil centred, 1 pushes it fully to the rim.
wondering-eye.hint.idleDrift: Wander slowly when there is nothing to watch.
wondering-eye.hint.respectVisibility: Stop tracking a target this client cannot see, so the gaze never reveals a hidden token.
wondering-eye.hint.users: Leave empty to show everyone. Gamemasters always see the eye.
wondering-eye.notify.noPlaceable: This object is not on the current scene.
wondering-eye.notify.pickPrompt: Click the spot on the canvas where the eye should sit.
wondering-eye.notify.pickDone: Socket position captured. Save the sheet to apply it.
wondering-eye.settings.debug.name: Debug logging
wondering-eye.settings.debug.hint: Log eye setup and target resolution to the console.
